description: Downloads RNA-seq and other sequencing FASTQ data from the ENA (European Nucleotide Archive) Portal API and exports run-level metadata. Resolves download URLs and file sizes from the structured API rather than scraping archive web pages, supports batch accession lists, HTTP Range resume for interrupted transfers, and MD5 verification against the checksums ENA publishes. This skill should be used when fetching raw sequencing reads by SRA/ERR/DRR accession, retrieving FASTQ files for an RNA-seq project, or collecting run metadata and read counts is requested.
